entry.title: setup downloads the pinned Kiku release and writes the manifest from …
entry.content:
setup downloads the pinned Kiku release and writes the manifest from decks/; note counts baselined from the first import

- kiku/ holds the Kiku release package; setup downloads the manifest's version, --kiku-version picks another
- setup appends one [[sources]] entry per deck file, converter filled when detected, placeholder otherwise
- source note type and count are remembered in state after import; expect blocks are optional overrides
- upgrade-kiku --version downloads and records the new release
- docs: quick start, guide, command reference and headless page rewritten for the flow
